spotlights.name: system-design-maker
spotlights.tagline: Zero-backend system-design tool — custom DSL, live request flow
spotlights.description: Design a system in a small DSL and watch it render as an architecture diagram, then play requests flowing through it in real time — services, queues, and datastores as text, animated end-to-end. Entirely client-side, no backend.
bullets: Custom DSL parsed in the browser into an interactive architecture diagram — define services, queues, and datastores as text and get a live graph.
Animates requests flowing edge-to-edge through the design in real time, so you see how a system behaves rather than just drawing boxes.
Zero-backend and fully static — deployed on GitHub Pages, instant to load and share.

spotlights.name: InfraChat
spotlights.tagline: Distributed hybrid-RAG over Kubernetes & Docker docs
spotlights.description: A retrieval-augmented chat system that answers Kubernetes and Docker questions straight from the official docs — hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword) fused with RRF, then grounded generation with source links. Built as a modular monolith whose boundaries map 1:1 onto a microservices-on-Kubernetes target.
bullets: Hybrid retrieval: local bge-small embeddings in Qdrant + BM25 keyword search, fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion; every answer cites the doc chunks it came from.
Runs fully local and free — embedded Qdrant, CPU embeddings, and a local Ollama model (or Groq's free tier); retrieval still returns sources even when generation is offline.
Roadmap splits the modules into services on Kubernetes — Orchestrator, Retrieval, Reranker, and an LLM gateway, with a Redis cache, ElasticSearch, and Helm packaging.

spotlights.name: Get equivalently better with less precision
spotlights.tagline: PEFT methods — LoRA & QLoRA — reproduced from scratch · COMP 433
spotlights.description: Two-person deep-learning research project: instead of trusting the papers' numbers, we reimplemented parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods from scratch and benchmarked them on a single RTX 3090.
bullets: Implemented LoRA adapters by hand — modifying Q/K/V projections in PyTorch — and QLoRA (4-bit NF4) for single-GPU fine-tuning of GPT-Neo and Qwen2.5.
Benchmarked accuracy, F1, and VRAM across SST-2, SQuAD v1.1, Wikitext-2, and AlpacaEval — rank-8 LoRA cut GPT-2 perplexity from 54.3 to 31.6.
Full research writeup: proposal, progress report, and final report with training-loss analysis.

spotlights.name: PlayLocal
spotlights.tagline: Location-based platform for organizing local pickup sports
spotlights.description: Find a game nearby, see who's in, and actually show up. Team capstone built production-shaped: quality gates, coverage tracking, and a real deploy pipeline. I led backend and release engineering across 108 commits.
bullets: Spring Boot backend: auth profiles, Flyway DB migrations, transactional email (Brevo), and CI test configuration.
Reviewed and merged feature work from an AI assistant with knowledge-grounded, user-aware answers to weather forecasts for upcoming games.
Production pipeline: SonarCloud quality gate + Codecov, deployed on Netlify and Render with Neon Postgres.
